concept: India under East India Company’s Rule
question: Under which Act was the rule of British Crown established over India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Government of India Act 1858**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The rule of the British Crown over India was established under the **Government of India Act 1858**.
 
• This act marked the** end of rule by the British East India Company** and the administration of India was taken over directly by the British government.
